title: Nestfolio Pipeline Configuration
description: Defines deployment metadata for a Nestfolio service stack.

subsystem.description: The domain subsystem this service belongs to.

deploymentPhase.description: Deployment phase ordering (1 = hubs, 2 = web/auth, 3 = BFFs/controllers/adapters).

parallelDeploy.description: Whether this service can be deployed in parallel with others in the same phase.

dependencies.description: List of Nx project names this service depends on for deployment ordering.
